ucs.title: [LLM] ALPHV/BlackCat shadow-copy wipe + Rust ransomware execution chain
ucs.description: Hunts BlackCat/ALPHV's signature pre-encryption tradecraft: deleting Volume Shadow Copies via vssadmin/wmic and disabling recovery via bcdedit immediately before the Rust-compiled locker (sha256-tracked Noberus binaries) drops .sykffle/.alphv-style ransom notes. Targets the encryptor's known CLI flags (--access-token, --propagated, --no-prop) which are unique to ALPHV's affiliate-built Rust payload.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe","powershell.exe","cmd.exe") AND (Processes.process="*delete shadows*" OR Processes.process="*shadowcopy delete*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled No*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*delete catalog -quiet*" OR Processes.process="*--access-token*" OR Processes.process="*--propagated*" OR Processes.process="*--no-prop-servers*" OR Processes.process="*--child*" OR Processes.process="*-no-net*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eventstats dc(process_name) as distinct_bins by dest user | where distinct_bins>=2 | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let WindowMin = 30m;
let RecoveryWipe = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName in~ ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","shadowcopy delete","recoveryenabled No","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures","delete catalog -quiet")
    | project RecoveryTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, RecoveryCmd = ProcessCommandLine, RecoveryBin = FileName;
let AlphvFlags = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("--access-token","--propagated","--no-prop-servers","--child","-no-net","--ui","--bypass")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (".exe","--access-token=")
    | project AlphvTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, AlphvCmd = ProcessCommandLine, AlphvBin = FileName, AlphvSha = SHA256;
RecoveryWipe
| join kind=inner AlphvFlags on DeviceId
| where AlphvTime between (RecoveryTime - WindowMin .. RecoveryTime + WindowMin)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project RecoveryTime, AlphvTime, DeviceName, AccountName, RecoveryBin, RecoveryCmd, AlphvBin, AlphvCmd, AlphvSha
| order by RecoveryTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let WindowMin = 30m;
let RecoveryWipe = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where NewProcessName has_any ("vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","bcdedit.exe","wbadmin.exe")
    | where CommandLine has_any ("delete shadows","shadowcopy delete","recoveryenabled No","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures","delete catalog -quiet")
    | project RecoveryTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, RecoveryCmd = CommandLine, RecoveryBin = NewProcessName;
let AlphvFlags = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where CommandLine has_any ("--access-token","--propagated","--no-prop-servers","--child","-no-net","--ui","--bypass")
    | project AlphvTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, AlphvCmd = CommandLine, AlphvBin = NewProcessName;
RecoveryWipe
| join kind=inner AlphvFlags on Computer
| where AlphvTime between (RecoveryTime - WindowMin .. RecoveryTime + WindowMin)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project RecoveryTime, AlphvTime, Computer, SubjectUserName, RecoveryBin, RecoveryCmd, AlphvBin, AlphvCmd
| order by RecoveryTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:(1 OR 4688)) (@CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"shadowcopy delete"* OR *"recoveryenabled No"* OR *"bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"* OR *"--access-token"* OR *"--propagated"* OR *"--no-prop-servers"* OR *"--child"*)) (@Image:(*\vssadmin.exe OR *\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\VSSADMIN.EXE OR *\wmic.exe OR *\WMIC.exe OR *\bcdedit.exe OR *\BCDEdit.exe OR *\BCDEDIT.EXE OR *\wbadmin.exe OR *\WBAdmin.exe))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/(vssadmin|wmic|bcdedit|wbadmin)\.exe$/i OR CommandLine=/(--access-token|--propagated|--no-prop-servers|--child\s|-no-net)/i
| CommandLine=/(delete\s+shadows|shadowcopy\s+delete|recoveryenabled\s+No|bootstatuspolicy\s+ignoreallfailures|delete\s+catalog\s+-quiet|--access-token=|--propagated|--no-prop-servers)/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName], function=collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData, _time]))
| length(CommandLine) > 1
ucs.rationale: BlackCat/ALPHV (Noberus) is the first Rust-compiled RaaS and its encryptor takes signature CLI flags --access-token / --propagated / --no-prop-servers / --child that no benign software uses. ucs.title: [LLM] ALPHV/BlackCat affiliate access via spear-phish → Cobalt Strike beacon → RDP lateral movement
ucs.description: Hunts the BlackCat affiliate intrusion playbook documented by Microsoft (DEV-0237/FIN12 hand-offs into ALPHV) and Mandiant: malicious-attachment-or-link delivery → LSASS credential dump → RDP lateral movement to a domain controller. Chain pivots on the same user across email, process, and logon telemetry within 12 hours — the signature ALPHV pre-encryption sequence.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Email where (All_Email.delivery_action="delivered" AND (All_Email.file_name="*.iso" OR All_Email.file_name="*.img" OR All_Email.file_name="*.lnk" OR All_Email.file_name="*.zip" OR All_Email.file_name="*.html")) by All_Email.recipient All_Email.src_user _time | rename All_Email.* as * | rename recipient as user | eval phish_time=_time | append [| tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("rundll32.exe","procdump.exe","taskmgr.exe","comsvcs.dll") AND (Processes.process="*lsass*" OR Processes.process="*MiniDump*" OR Processes.process="*comsvcs.dll, MiniDump*")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process _time | rename Processes.* as * | eval lsass_time=_time] | append [| tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Authentication where (Authentication.signature_id="4624" AND Authentication.authentication_method="10") by Authentication.dest Authentication.user Authentication.src _time | rename Authentication.* as * | eval rdp_time=_time] | stats min(phish_time) as phish max(lsass_time) as lsass max(rdp_time) as rdp values(src) as src_ip values(dest) as host by user | where isnotnull(phish) AND isnotnull(lsass) AND isnotnull(rdp) AND (rdp-phish)<43200 AND lsass>phish AND rdp>lsass
ucs.kql:
let Window = 12h;
let Phish = EmailEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where DeliveryAction == "Delivered"
    | join kind=inner (EmailAttachmentInfo | where FileName has_any (".iso",".img",".lnk",".zip",".html",".htm",".one")) on NetworkMessageId
    | project PhishTime = Timestamp, AccountUpn = RecipientEmailAddress, SenderFromAddress, Subject, FileName;
let LsassDump = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where (InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("rundll32.exe","procdump.exe","procdump64.exe","taskmgr.exe") and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("comsvcs.dll, MiniDump","MiniDumpW","lsass.dmp","-ma lsass"))
        or (ProcessCommandLine has "lsass" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("MiniDump","comsvcs.dll"))
    | project DumpTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountUpn, DumpCmd = ProcessCommandLine;
let RdpLat = DeviceLogonEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where ActionType == "LogonSuccess" and LogonType == "RemoteInteractive"
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | project RdpTime = Timestamp, RdpTarget = DeviceName, AccountUpn = strcat(AccountName,"@",AccountDomain), RemoteIP;
Phish
| join kind=inner LsassDump on AccountUpn
| where DumpTime between (PhishTime .. PhishTime + Window)
| join kind=inner RdpLat on AccountUpn
| where RdpTime between (DumpTime .. DumpTime + Window)
| project PhishTime, DumpTime, RdpTime, AccountUpn, SenderFromAddress, Subject, FileName, DeviceName, DumpCmd, RdpTarget, RemoteIP
| order by RdpTime desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let Window = 12h;
let Phish = EmailEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where DeliveryAction == "Delivered"
    | project PhishTime = TimeGenerated, UPN = RecipientEmailAddress, SenderFromAddress, Subject, AttachmentCount;
let LsassDump = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | where (NewProcessName has_any ("rundll32.exe","procdump.exe","procdump64.exe","taskmgr.exe") and CommandLine has_any ("comsvcs.dll, MiniDump","MiniDumpW","lsass.dmp","-ma lsass"))
        or (CommandLine has "lsass" and CommandLine has_any ("MiniDump","comsvcs.dll"))
    | extend UPN = strcat(SubjectUserName,"@",SubjectDomainName)
    | project DumpTime = TimeGenerated, Computer, UPN, DumpCmd = CommandLine;
let RdpLat = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventID == 4624 and LogonType == 10
    | where TargetUserName !endswith "$"
    | extend UPN = strcat(TargetUserName,"@",TargetDomainName)
    | project RdpTime = TimeGenerated, RdpTarget = Computer, UPN, RemoteIP = IpAddress;
Phish
| join kind=inner LsassDump on UPN
| where DumpTime between (PhishTime .. PhishTime + Window)
| join kind=inner RdpLat on UPN
| where RdpTime between (DumpTime .. DumpTime + Window)
| project PhishTime, DumpTime, RdpTime, UPN, SenderFromAddress, Subject, Computer, DumpCmd, RdpTarget, RemoteIP
| order by RdpTime desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:(1 OR 4688)) (@Image:(*\rundll32.exe OR *\RunDll32.exe OR *\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\procdump.exe OR *\ProcDump.exe OR *\procdump64.exe OR *\ProcDump64.exe OR *\taskmgr.exe OR *\TaskMgr.exe)) (@CommandLine:(*"comsvcs.dll, MiniDump"* OR *"MiniDumpW"* OR *"lsass.dmp"* OR *"-ma lsass"* OR *"lsass"*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/(rundll32|procdump(64)?|taskmgr)\.exe$/i
| CommandLine=/(comsvcs\.dll,\s*MiniDump|MiniDumpW|lsass\.dmp|-ma\s+lsass|lsass.*MiniDump)/i
| join({#event_simpleName=UserLogon LogonType=10}, field=[aid], include=[UserName, RemoteAddressIP4, LogonTime])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine, RemoteAddressIP4, _time]))
ucs.rationale: BlackCat/ALPHV affiliates (per Microsoft DEV-0237/Sangria Tempest hand-offs and the March 2022 FBI FLASH) follow a tight phish→LSASS→RDP-to-DC chain within hours. Joining all three telemetry tables on the same UPN within a 12-hour window converts three medium-signal events into a single high-signal incident; benign users virtually never receive an .iso/.lnk phish, dump LSASS via comsvcs MiniDump,
